items.title: All three major Nepal-China crossings hit by monsoon disruptions ahead of Dashain
items.summary: Floods and landslides have halted trade through Rasuwagadhi-Kerung, Tatopani, and Korala border points. Hundreds of containers remain stranded and supplies disrupted ahead of the festive season.
